patch.summary: 7shifts cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: 7shifts pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Comp (Free). 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: 7shifts cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price 7shifts against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Comp (Free) until a gated capability (payroll processing (Comp (Free), Essentials, Pro, Premium)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (applicant tracking, career site and job boards, workforce scheduling) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Hospitality-specialist — not a general retail/field WFM. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
